title: Microbubble synthesis of hybridised bacterial cellulose–gelatin separators for multifunctional supercapacitors
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01684J, Paper
Surachai Chaichana, Pawin Iamprasertkun, Montree Sawangphruk, Noelia Rubio, Pichamon Sirisinudomkit
This study introduces durable hybridised bacterial cellulose–gelatin separators synthesised via a facile microbubble process, offering enhanced electrochemical performance for innovative energy storage applications.
